boundary: Actual CI evidence. The four named Dart business cases and one XCTest passed with the unchanged leak and real Keychain assertions; setUpAll and tearDownAll are not additional business passes. The actual freshly built host signature was verified ad-hoc without a team or provisioning profile. Signing metadata alone does not prove Keychain permission; the separate real Keychain read/write/new-instance-read/delete case passed. The app-stop controller still failed without exposing the underlying guard/command/close category, so overall CI remains failure and backup/new Photos/normal-entry steps did not execute. Separate owned-device Shutdown/delete/absence cleanup was confirmed. No arbitrary ESRCH output, XCTest response or host exit is treated as application-stop proof. Both original artifacts were downloaded with closed streams and verified against their exact GitHub byte counts and SHA-256. No physical PT, minimum OS, hardware PERF, real-service or Apple formal-signing claim.
